steps: Ask the assistant for the best sellers of today, the last 7 days or the last 30 days (default 30); it returns name, units sold and revenue for the top 1 to 10
The figures are the store's own analytics, read live; the assistant quotes them as returned and never estimates
edgeCases: No store bound (standalone workspace): the tool is not offered
Store unreachable: the assistant says it could not read the store data, it never guesses a number
Orders-today and total-sales questions are NOT answered by this tool (the assistant points to the store dashboard)
gaps: No screen yet: the assistant reads it, or the route
